population_policy: Measured architectural last-micro retirement; union read/write membership across retained warmup and measurement records; atomic may count in both. Owner and CPL at retirement. Functional membership is not ISA event certification.
source_policy: Scalar estimate: any miss, else non-L1 fill follower, else L1/forward estimate; entire macro unclassified when any load member lacks a source. No subset error scoring.
privilege_and_owner_scopes: physical=user+kernel=workload_task+other_task; instruction CPL and owner at architectural retirement; member UOP denominators at individual member retirement
speculative_policy: Only committed measured macros; speculative instruction/request events are excluded from this domain
reset_boundary: Common measurement start resets totals while retained warmup macro membership and native source identities survive; last-micro must retire in measurement; partial common-end tail is not completed

increment_sites.gem5: TaoTrace::accountPerfRetirementCommit -> retirement::Ledger::commit; resolvePerfRetirementNative joins immutable context/sequence native identities before old registry reduction
increment_sites.fastsim: PerfRetirementLedger::accept after the accepted functional prefix and timing-feedback commit; final scope reduction in simulator.cpp/main.cpp

conservation: Within each available scope: hits+misses+fb_hits=classified_loads; classified_loads+unclassified_loads=retired_loads. This is this model's scalar mapping, not a universal hardware partition. Sum per-core scopes equals aggregate; retired_loads and retired_stores each <= retired_macro_instructions.
native_ROM_boundary: Known x86 external ROM entry may establish a complete functional macro without IsFirstMicroop; other missing native starts remain unavailable. These functional pseudo-macros are not certified hardware architectural retired instructions.

request_events.legacy_L2_LLC: non-authoritative request proxies; not retired instruction counts

functional_request_role_policy.software_prefetch: New producer and role-v2 model retire the instruction but exclude its architectural load/store result.
functional_request_role_policy.legacy_sources: V1 and undeclared streams retain historical functional populations; no inferred hint identity.
functional_request_role_policy.source_audit: Independent FST retirement scan verifies bound role rows; full FST consumer separately verifies stream hash.
